newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-GANZ PULLS INTER OUT OF TROUBLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GANZ PULLS INTER OUT OF TROUBLE.

text.p: Second-half substitute Maurizio Ganz struck 15 minutes from time to earn Internazionale a hard-fought 1-1 draw with Anderlecht in their UEFA Cup quarter-final first-leg match on Tuesday.
Ganz's strike, after goalkeeper Geert De Vlieger fumbled a surprise overhead kick by Marco Branca, cancelled out a 27th minute effort by former Belgian international Bruno Versavel.
Versavel blasted an unstoppable half volley from just outside the box past Gianluca Pagliuca after taking a Tibor Selymes pass from the left.
Inter, bidding to win the UEFA Cup for the third time in seven seasons, nearly had a winner when Ganz hit the post in the 88th minute.
